# `remove_docket_from_tag`

**Remove Docket from Tag**

- **Source:** `courtlistener/mcp/tools/remove_docket_from_tag_tool.py`
- **Estimated definition size:** ~265 tokens (description ~81, input schema ~95; cl100k_base)
- **Parameters:** 2 (2 required)
- **Raw input schema:** [`remove_docket_from_tag.inputs.json`](./remove_docket_from_tag.inputs.json)

## Description

Remove a docket from one of the user's tags on CourtListener.

Looks the docket up in the tag by docket ID, so you don't need the
docket tag's own ID. The tag and the docket themselves are untouched.

Use `call_endpoint` with endpoint_id "docket-tags" to see which
dockets are in a tag (filter by `tag`).
